about:
Quality Sheet Metal & Welding was founded in 1997 in Piscataway, New Jersey. The company operates as a sheet metal and steel fabrication shop serving commercial, industrial, and pharmaceutical clients. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom stainless steel fabrication, industrial ductwork, HVAC system design and installation, high-definition plasma cutting (up to 3/4-inch plate), dust collection systems, 3D printing in multiple polymers, fume and compressor exhaust ducts, DuctSox fabric ducting, polished stainless steel work (including 316L for pharmaceutical and food-grade applications), structural steel platforms and mezzanines, OSHA-compliant machine guards, and on-site welding. It also performs scheduled shut-down work and emergency off-hours projects with 24/7 project communication.

Customers span commercial construction, industrial manufacturing, pharmaceutical and cosmetic production, recycling facilities, 3D printing service bureaus, and carpentry/cabinet shops. The company has completed thousands of projects for clients ranging from small businesses to large industrial facilities.

Quality Sheet Metal & Welding emphasizes a broad service range, creative custom solutions, hands-on management, and a safety-first culture backed by OSHA certifications. It holds a master HVAC license (19HC00288200) and is affiliated with the Associated Builders & Contractors Association.
